key_points: AI sentiment index rose to 77.78 in Aug 2026, signaling broader enterprise AI deployment.
Broadcom completed a $10.9B multi‑year share buyback and announced new AI chip deals with hyperscalers.
Anthropic added as a new AI customer, diversifying Broadcom’s AI revenue base.
JPMorgan rated Broadcom an "aggressive buyer" at current levels.
China’s audit of Broadcom’s state‑data‑center ties creates a regulatory headwind but likely limited near‑term impact.
